records.jp: いいよ！<CR>どうしたの？
records.en_original: Sure! What's up?
records.en: Sure! What's up?

records.jp: お菓子を作ってみたの。<CR>よかったら一緒に食べない？
records.en_original: I've made some snacks. Would you like to have some with me?
records.en: I've made some snacks. Would you like to have some with me?

records.jp: ふう、ごちそうさま！<CR>おいしかったー！
records.en_original: Whew, thanks! Those were delicious!
records.en: Whew, thanks! Those were delicious!

records.jp: ふふ、よかった
records.en_original: Hehe, I'm glad.
records.en: Hehe, I'm glad.

records.jp: あれから陽桜莉さんの様子はどう？
records.en_original: How have things been with Hiori?
records.en: How have things been with Hiori?

records.jp: また話しかけてくれるようになったわ。<CR>愛央のおかげで、あまり構いすぎなくなったから
records.en_original: She's started speaking with me again. I took your advice and left some space between us.
records.en: She's started speaking with me again. I took your advice and left some space between us.

records.jp: おお！　思いつきの作戦だったけど、<CR>やってみるもんだ！
records.en_original: Oh, that's great! I kinda just came up with it in the moment, but I'm glad it worked.
records.en: Oh, that's great! I kinda just came up with it in the moment, but I'm glad it worked.

records.jp: もう、適当だったの？
records.en_original: Does that mean you weren't taking my problem seriously?
records.en: Does that mean you weren't taking my problem seriously?

records.jp: いやいや、大真面目！　うん！
records.en_original: No, I was totally serious! Cross my heart!
records.en: No, I was totally serious! Cross my heart!

records.jp: ふふ……
records.en_original: Hehe...
records.en: Hehe...

records.jp: それにしても、もったいないなあ陽桜莉さん。<CR>こんなに優しいお姉さん、私なら離れないのに
records.en_original: Hiori sure is letting a good thing go to waste, though. I'd love a sister like you.
records.en: Hiori sure is letting a good thing go to waste, though. I'd love a sister like you.

records.jp: ……私は、あなたが思うほどできた姉ではないわ
records.en_original: I'm not the sister that you think I am.
records.en: I'm not the sister that you think I am.

records.jp: え？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: 話したかしら。<CR>私と陽桜莉が前に仲違いしていたこと
records.en_original: Have I told you? Things used to be very different between Hiori and I.
records.en: Have I told you? Things used to be very different between Hiori and I.

records.jp: ……ある時、リフレクターの力を使って、<CR>人々の想いを管理しようとしたの
records.en_original: There was a time when I used my powers as a Reflector to try and control people's emotions.
records.en: There was a time when I used my powers as a Reflector to try and control people's emotions.

records.jp: そうすれば、みんなが……いいえ、陽桜莉が<CR>苦しまない世界になると思って
records.en_original: I thought that by doing that, people... Hiori, would be able to live in a world without suffering.
records.en: I thought that by doing that, people... Hiori, would be able to live in a world without suffering.

records.jp: けれど、あの子はそんなことは望んでいなかった。<CR>だから……私と陽桜莉は剣を向け合うことになった
records.en_original: But it wasn't what she wanted. In the end, we fought.
records.en: But it wasn't what she wanted. In the end, we fought.

records.jp: 許されないことをしたわ
records.en_original: What I did was unforgivable.
records.en: What I did was unforgivable.

records.jp: そ、そんなことが……
records.en_original: That's terrible...
records.en: That's terrible...

records.jp: でも、そんな私を陽桜莉が助けてくれた。<CR>だから私は、こうしてまた陽桜莉と過ごせている
records.en_original: Even still, Hiori saved me. It's thanks to her that I can be with her again.
records.en: Even still, Hiori saved me. It's thanks to her that I can be with her again.

records.jp: ……もしかして、美弦さんが言ってた<CR>「報いたい」って……
records.en_original: Is that what you meant when you said you wanted to make it up to Hiori then?
records.en: Is that what you meant when you said you wanted to make it up to Hiori then?

records.jp: そう……あの時陽桜莉からもらった想いに報いたい
records.en_original: Indeed. I must repay Hiori for returning my emotions to me.
records.en: Indeed. I must repay Hiori for returning my emotions to me.

records.jp: ……なんてことを言いながら、<CR>その実私が陽桜莉から離れられなかっただけなのかも
records.en_original: ...Though the truth is likely that I simply cannot bring myself to let her go.
records.en: ...Though the truth is likely that I simply cannot bring myself to let her go.

records.jp: 美弦さん……
records.en_original: Mio...
records.en: Mio...

records.jp: ……確かに、美弦さんはとんでもないことを<CR>してしまったんだと思う
records.en_original: It's true that you did something bad.
records.en: It's true that you did something bad.

records.jp: でも、やっぱり私には美弦さんが優しいお姉さんに<CR>見えるよ
records.en_original: Still, I think you're a very kind person.
records.en: Still, I think you're a very kind person.

records.jp: だって、全部陽桜莉さんのことを思って<CR>やったことなんだろうから
records.en_original: I mean, you did everything you did for Hiori, didn't you?
records.en: I mean, you did everything you did for Hiori, didn't you?

records.jp: ……そうね。でも……
records.en_original: Yes, but...
records.en: Yes, but...

records.jp: 間違った想いは人だって殺す
records.en_original: Misguided feelings can even drive a person to kill.
records.en: Misguided feelings can even drive a person to kill.

records.jp: 一度間違えた私は、また間違えるかもしれない。<CR>私は私を……信じられない
records.en_original: I was wrong once, and it could happen again. I can't trust myself...
records.en: I was wrong once, and it could happen again. I can't trust myself...

records.jp: （……きっと美弦さんをそう思わせてしまうだけの<CR>過去があったんだ）
records.en_original: (Those experiences must be the reason she thinks like this.)
records.en: (Those experiences must be the reason she thinks like this.)

records.jp: （悔しいな……その過去は、私の手の届かない<CR>ところにある）
records.en_original: (I hate this. As much as I might want to, I can't change what happened.)
records.en: (I hate this. As much as I might want to, I can't change what happened.)

records.jp: （けど……それでも……）
records.en_original: (Even so...)
records.en: (Even so...)

records.jp: ああ、そうか……
records.en_original: Ahh, I see now.
records.en: Ahh, I see now.

records.jp: もしかしたら私は、陽桜莉に報いたいんじゃなくて……。<CR>この罪悪感を晴らすために……
records.en_original: I've been lying to myself. My actions aren't a form of repayment, but simply a way to relieve my own guilt.
records.en: I've been lying to myself. My actions aren't a form of repayment, but simply a way to relieve my own guilt.

records.jp: ……愛央？
……なんて、いうか……うまく言えないけど……
records.en_original: How do I say this... This may not be the best way to put this, but...
records.en: How do I say this... This may not be the best way to put this, but...

records.jp: ……それでも、いいじゃん。<CR>罪悪感を晴らすためでも、さ
records.en_original: I don't think that's such a bad thing.
records.en: I don't think that's such a bad thing.

records.jp: 私は、それでも美弦さんは美弦さんだと思うから……
records.en_original: No matter what, you're still you.
records.en: No matter what, you're still you.

records.jp: 愛央……
records.en_original: Ao...
records.en: Ao...

records.jp: 私、付き合うよ。その償いに
records.en_original: And I'll stick with you, as long as you feel you need to atone.
records.en: And I'll stick with you, as long as you feel you need to atone.

records.jp: ……ありがとう
records.en_original: ...Thank you.
records.en: ...Thank you.

records.jp: （……この罪悪感がなくならない限り、美弦さんは<CR>きっと本当の意味で妹離れすることができない）
records.en_original: (As long as Mio has that guilt, she won't be able to separate herself from Hiori.)
records.en: (As long as Mio has that guilt, she won't be able to separate herself from Hiori.)

records.jp: （そしてその罪悪感は、いくら陽桜莉さんや私が<CR>大丈夫だよって言ったところで晴れないんだ）
records.en_original: (But it won't go away just because Hiori or I tell her it's okay.)
records.en: (But it won't go away just because Hiori or I tell her it's okay.)

records.jp: （美弦さん自身が自分を許さなくちゃ。<CR>でも、それにはどうしたら……？）
records.en_original: (Mio has to forgive herself. But how...?)
records.en: (Mio has to forgive herself. But how...?)

records.jp: <CLGR>美弦<CLNR>のタレントに<CR>新たなタレントタイプが解放されました
records.en_original: A new Talent Type has been unlocked in <CLGR>Mio's<CLNR> Talents.
records.en: A new Talent Type has been unlocked in <CLGR>Mio's<CLNR> Talents.
